subject: Admin activity export options and delivery handshake - Greenline Health
messages:
From: Greenline Security <security@greenline.com>

Cc: auditcorp-docs@auditcorp.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity export options for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Priya,

We're preparing our SOC 2 evidence bundle and need a clear description of how Redwood logs and can export admin activity (operator/admin actions, role changes, API keys, credential rotations). Specifically we need:

- A list of fields you record for each admin action (actor id, action, target, resource id, timestamp, IP, user agent, request id, session id, pre/post state diffs if available).
- Retention policy and whether per-tenant retention windows are supported.
- Export delivery options (S3 presigned, SFTP, temporary tenant-scoped bucket, signed manifest).
- Encryption / KMS expectations and whether you can use our customer-managed KMS key.
- How you handle PII redaction / tokenization for exports and whether exports can omit user-visible PII.
- Attestation (HMAC manifest, signed manifest) and SLA for on-demand exports.

Can you also provide an example manifest and a rough timeline for a one-off export (30 days of admin activity) to be delivered to our security team?

Regards,
Asha Mehta
Security Architect, Greenline Health
security@greenline.com

Attachments: none

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example>
To: Greenline Security <security@greenline.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, kimberly_park@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity export options for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below and I'm attaching a short export-options summary and an example CSV manifest for your team to review.

Summary (high level):
- Logged fields: actor_id, actor_email (optional redaction), action_type, target_type, target_id, timestamp (RFC3339), request_id, session_id, source_ip, user_agent, outcome (success/fail), kv_cache_event (when present), old_state/ new_state diffs (only for privileged-change events).
- Retention: default admin activity retention is 13 months. We can support custom retention windows per-customer under Dedicated/Private contracts; for hosted customers we offer 3/6/13 month tiers.
- Export formats: newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) or Parquet preferred for large exports; CSV available for small slices.
- Delivery: S3 (tenant-scoped bucket with customer-managed KMS or our ephemeral key, presigned URLs), SFTP push (credentialed), or secure transfer to an escrow provider. We provide an HMAC-signed manifest and SHA256 checksums for chunks.
- PII: exports can be configured to redact actor_email and other PII. Redaction happens prior to packaging; we also support tokenization mappings if you want reversible identifiers.
- Attestation & SLA: standard on-demand export SLA is 3 business days for up to 30 days of data. Expedited 24-48h windows can be arranged under an SOW. Manifests are HMAC-signed; we can add a PKI-signed attestation for enterprise/legal needs.

Next steps / questions for your team:
1) Delivery preference (S3 + your KMS / our KMS / SFTP).
2) If S3 with your KMS: please provide the ARN of the key and whether cross-account access is permitted.
3) If SFTP: hostname, port, user, public SSH key (we only push via key auth).
4) Do you want PII redacted or tokenized? If tokenized, who retains the mapping?

Attaching: export-options-summary.pdf, example-admin-manifest.csv

I'll loop in our ops lead (Vivek) for the handshake details once you confirm delivery preference.

Best,
Priya
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- export-options-summary.pdf (summary of formats / retention / delivery)
- example-admin-manifest.csv (column examples: chunk_name, sha256, lines, format, start_ts, end_ts)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example>, Asha Mehta <security@greenline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: admin activity export options for SOC 2 evidence

Priya / Asha — forwarding technical notes and a proposed small playbook for the export. I've included the exact field set and an outline of the delivery handshake we use.

--- Forwarded technical note ---
From: Vivek Kulkarni

Technical details / playbook (concise):
1) Field set exported (JSONL/Parquet):
   - event_id (UUID), timestamp (RFC3339), actor_id, actor_role, actor_email (redactable), action_type, action_subtype, target_type, target_id, target_attributes (map), request_id, trace_id, session_id, source_ip, user_agent, outcome, old_state (nullable), new_state (nullable), kv_cache_event (bool), internal_tags (array), region, replication_region

2) Packaging & chunking:
   - Exports are chunked by size (~500MB compressed) and time windows. Each chunk gets a filename like admin-20260701-20260707-chunk-0001.parquet.gz and a corresponding CRC/SHA256 in the manifest.

3) Encryption / KMS:
   - We support cross-account KMS if you provide an IAM role that grants encrypt/decrypt for the export bucket. Alternate: we encrypt server-side with your KMS key ARN during upload. If using SFTP, payloads are encrypted with AES-256 and the SSH channel is mandatory.

4) HMAC manifest & attestation:
   - Manifest format (CSV/JSON): chunk_name, sha256, compressed_bytes, rows, start_ts, end_ts. We HMAC the manifest using a per-export secret and provide the secret over a separate channel (verified voice or signed DocuSign request). For higher assurance we can produce a PKI-signed PDF attestation.

5) PII handling:
   - Redaction: actor_email removed and replaced with hashed_actor_id. Tokenization: reversible token stored in customer-only mapping under Private deployment (requires SOW).

6) Legal hold / preservation:
   - We can snapshot the tenant's admin activity index and persist an immutable copy for up to 7 years under an enterprise contract. Legal hold requests are handled via a signed request and require 48h notice for immutable packaging.

7) Timeline example (30 days):
   - Confirm delivery method & creds: 1 business day
   - Prepare export, chunking & HMAC manifest: 1 business day
   - Upload & verification: same day as export (depending on transfer speed)
   - Expected standard turnaround: 3 business days end-to-end

8) Ops handshake checklist we need from Greenline:
   - Preferred delivery: S3 (provide bucket/prefix and cross-account IAM role) OR SFTP (host, port, public key)
   - KMS ARN (if using your key)
   - Contact for HMAC secret exchange (name & phone)
   - Any redaction / tokenization policy (fields to redact)

Attachments: export_playbook_v1.md (playbook + example manifest generator script)

--- end forwarded note ---

Kimberly: FYI, the manifest template includes old_state/new_state only for privileged-change events — please confirm that's sufficient for your SOC2 auditor.
Ben: please update the HubSpot deal with delivery SLA options (standard vs expedited).

Vivek
Platform Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: export_playbook_v1.md

- KMS: we will use our CMK (ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345).

- Timeline: standard SLA (3 business days) is acceptable. Please confirm anticipated upload size estimate for 30 days (we expect ~2.5M lines).
